title: Saint Louis University, SSM Health Cardinal Glennon Children's Hospital Receive $2.15 Million Award as Part of Regional Pediatric Prevention Network
summary_en: Saint Louis University and SSM Health Cardinal Glennon Children's Hospital have received a $2.15 million award from the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) for the continuation of operations as a Pediatric Prevention Network (PPN).
